notes_for_editor: Brief agency 'Tower removed' is a status note and is corrected to the survey owner code; the expansion of Mn MFS to a named agency is not in the sources read, so it is left as the code. Build year is not in any source read, so the story says nothing about it. The removal account is an undated old-timer account reported in the survey, not confirmed elsewhere. The survey says 'northeast corner of the county', which the story does not repeat. The A-Z list (Wikimedia) repeats the tower #70 details and adds a 'CCC: S-57' note whose meaning is unclear, so it is not used. Searches: 2 WebSearch-equivalent calls. Reads: 3 distinct pages plus the A-Z list.
